title: U.S. Nuclear Body Gives Second SMR Permit in Six Months
source_used: GE Vernova Hitachi release as carried by The Electrical Distributor (tedmag.com)
key_facts: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) issued a construction permit to the Tennessee Valley Authority for a BWRX-300 small modular reactor at Clinch River, Oak Ridge, Tennessee.
It is the first such permit issued in the US for the BWRX-300, a 300-megawatt design from GE Vernova Hitachi.
Other BWRX-300 projects: Ontario Power Generation is building the first unit in Canada; Blue Energy filed a permit application for a Texas project in September 2026.
Industrial Info Resources headline calls it the second SMR permit in six months.
quote_evidence: The permit is the first issued in the United States for a BWRX-300 and represents a significant milestone for TVA, GVH, and the U.S. nuclear industry as the country advances toward a new generation of nuclear power deployment.
TVA submitted its construction permit application for Clinch River in April 2025.
why_it_matters_hint: A permit to build is a major step for small reactors, but the reactor still needs an operating license.
notes: Industrial Info's own article was paywalled; the permit itself was issued about 29 Sep 2026 per other outlets, so this is older news re-dated. The 'second in six months' claim is the headline only.
